title: India’s Yulu raises $93M as quick-commerce boom fuels e-bike demand
summary: Yulu, an Indian e-bike company, raised $93M and plans to expand its fleet to 200,000 bikes within two years while developing faster electric two-wheelers. The funding reflects strong investor confidence in e-bikes as a solution for last-mile delivery amid India's quick-commerce boom.
content: Yulu aims to have a fleet of 200,000 bikes in the next two years and faster electric two-wheelers, aiming at new logistics use cases.

zh.title: 印度初创公司Yulu筹集9300万美元，快速电商热潮推动电动自行车需求
zh.summary: 印度电动自行车公司Yulu筹集了9300万美元，计划在两年内将其车队扩展到20万辆自行车，同时开发更快的电动两轮车。这笔融资反映了投资者对电动自行车作为印度快速电商热潮中最后一公里配送解决方案的强烈信心。

title: Saber denies replacing Rideshare Stimulator’s writers with ChatGPT
summary: Developer Saber denies replacing writers with ChatGPT for the Rideshare Stimulator game, but former lead writer Stella Sacco claims she was replaced midway through development along with AI voice work. The dispute highlights ongoing tensions about AI adoption in game development.
content:
After a former lead writer claimed Saber "replaced me with ChatGPT," CEO Matthew Karch now claims, "Neither Saber nor Unigine have replaced any writers with AI," for the Rideshare "Stimulator" game announced last month, developed by Unigine.
The writer, Stella Sacco, says differently, however, posting on Bluesky that "I was lead writer on this one! And Saber replaced me with ChatGPT midway through development. All the passenger voices were AI too. Either they changed direction at some point or they're not disclosing it on Steam." 
Saber describes Rideshare "Stimulator" as an "immersive driving simulation game that puts you behind the wheel …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: Saber否认用ChatGPT替换《Rideshare Stimulator》的编剧
zh.summary: 游戏开发公司Saber否认用ChatGPT替换《Rideshare Stimulator》游戏的编剧，但前主编剧Stella Sacco声称她在开发中途被替换，并配合AI配音。这场争议突显了游戏开发中对AI应用的持续紧张关系。

title: DEF CON crowd suspected in fake-hotspot attack on Delta flight
summary: The FBI is investigating a fake hotspot attack on a Delta flight allegedly carried out by DEF CON attendees, with no arrests made yet. The incident raises cybersecurity concerns at major hacker conferences.
content: FBI Atlanta confirms it's looking into the incident, no arrests made.

zh.title: DEF CON参与者涉嫌对达美航班发动虚假热点攻击
zh.summary: FBI正在调查一起据称由DEF CON参与者发动的达美航班虚假热点攻击，目前尚未逮捕任何人。该事件引发了人们对大型黑客大会网络安全的担忧。
